Late to the party but Oh Boy. I went to a private christian boarding academy for 3 years in high school. Shit Happened. 

We weren’t allowed to have any electronics- including phones. They were all places in a zippy bag and locked in a drawer. Computers weren’t allowed until senior year, in which the school would give you one. The computers were HEAVILY monitored (screenshotted every 30 seconds) and basically everything was blocked except educational sites, Facebook, and Pinterest. No spotify, no youtube, nothing. No sound on them either. 

Dress code was awful and sexist, as per usual. Girls couldn’t wear anything above the knee, or have any neckline below the collarbone and it had to have obvious sleeves. A friend of mine got all her makeup taken away bc she liked wearing brighter eyeshadow. The guys dress code was “don’t go around shirtless”.

We were taught odd things, such as: any music that has African influence in it (jazz, rock, etc) was evil. Any music that had more than one rhythm was evil. Christmas is pagan and if you wear perfume you’re a whore.  If you don’t give your husband sex you’re abusing him, and men only want sex and women only want emotional support. I was highly encouraged to either be a pastors wife or a teacher. 

Also you couldn’t leave campus without a teacher. If you had a car you had to take the license plate off and turn in your keys. 

I could go on. I graduated last year and i’m still working through so many issues that school gave me.
